headline: Public hearings on a home at 103 Oswald Street and a subdivision at 982 York Avenue, plus a 123-unit project at 30 Beecher Street.
summary: The 103 Oswald Street review continues a hearing that was tabled in October. Three workshops will give status updates on zoning rules, subdivision rules, and the Comprehensive Plan.
items: Public hearing on a two-story home at 103 Oswald Street, with zoning variances (continued from October)
Public hearing on a minor subdivision at 982 York Avenue, with lot size, frontage, setback, and four-family use variances
Public hearing on preliminary plan for Nulco Lofts Phase 2 at 30 Beecher Street, adding 123 residential units
Workshop on the Zoning Ordinance update
Workshop on the Land Development and Subdivision Regulations update
Workshop on the Comprehensive Plan update
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex Conference Room (Room 140), 100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI 02860

PUBLIC HEARING 
 
Unified Development Review (DPR)                     (VOTE TAKEN) 
103 Oswald Street (AP 29 Lot 240) 
Applicant Muhammed Qandil seeks approval to construct a two-story, 2,300-square-foot home on a 
+/- 6,154 sq. ft. lot of land, owned by Bermudez and Rojas Realty. Pursuant to RIGL § 45-23-50.1, this 
proposal is subject to Unified Development Review as the applicant is requesting a Dimensional 
Variance under § 410-46(A)(4) of the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance for minimum side setback 
between principal structures and § 410-44 for maximum height. This hearing is a continuance 
after commissioners tabled the application at the October 20, 2026 City Planning Commission 
Regular Meeting.  
 
E. New Business  
 
PUBLIC HEARING 
 
Unified Development Review (Minor Subdivision)                (VOTE TAKEN) 
982 York Avenue (AP 18 Lots 271 & 272) 
Applicants George & Vera Tenreiro seek approval for a minor subdivision of two parcels identified 
as Assessor’s Plat 18 Lots 271 & 272, currently addressed as 982 York Ave, and zoned as Residential 
Two-Family (RT). Lot 271 is currently +/- 5,000 sq. ft. in area, and Lot 272 is +/- 6,200 sq. ft. in area. 
The proposed parcels, Parcel 1 and Parcel 2, would be 6,429 sq. ft. and 4,747 sq. ft., respectively.

Major Land Development Project, Preliminary Plan Review                       (VOTE TAKEN) 
30 Beecher Street (AP 45B Lots 444 and 445) 
Applicants Nulco Lofts LLC and Piccadilly LLC seek preliminary plan approval of a major land 
development project for the construction of the Nulco Lofts – Phase 2 multifamily residential 
development on a +/- 342,780 sq. ft. (+/- 7.87-acre) tract of land zoned Conant Thread (CT), fronting 
on Beecher Street, identified as Assessor’s Plat 45, Lots 444 and 445, and addressed as 30 Beecher 
Street. The proposed project would add 123 residential units adjacent to an existing residential 
adaptive-reuse mill building also owned by Nulco Lofts LLC and Piccadilly LLC. 
 
PUBLIC MEETING 
 
Workshop                                                            (NO VOTE TAKEN) 
Zoning Ordinance Update 
The Planning & Redevelopment Department is in the process of updating the Zoning Ordinance in 
response to recent legislative updates to Rhode Island General Laws. The proposed changes will 
bring the Zoning Ordinance into compliance with these legislative updates and address 
inconsistencies, errors, and omissions in the existing Zoning Ordinance. This agenda item provides 
a status update on the in-progress Zoning Ordinance update. 
 
Workshop                                                            (NO VOTE TAKEN) 
Land Development and Subdivision Regulations Update  
The Planning & Redevelopment Department is in the process of updating the Land Development 
and Subdivision Regulations in response to recent legislative updates to Rhode Island General Laws. 
The proposed changes will bring the Land Development and Subdivision Regulations into 
compliance with these legislative updates and address inconsistencies, errors, and omissions in the 
existing Zoning Ordinance. This agenda item provides a status update on the in-progress Land 
Development and Subdivision Regulations update. 
 
Workshop                                                            (NO VOTE TAKEN) 
Comprehensive Plan Update 
The Planning & Redevelopment Department is updating the Comprehensive Plan to better align with 
community sentiment, recent updates to Rhode Island General Laws, and recent revisions to several 
elements of the State Guide Plan. This agenda item provides updates on the progress of the 
Comprehensive Plan update, including new data and maps, community engagement programming, 
and project branding. 
 
F. Director’s Report
